description: This Dart source file defines the AppState class which manages global state for a web login automation Flutter app. It handles credentials, login flags, UI selectors, persistence with SharedPreferences, and notifies listeners on state updates.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that holds the application's global state, including user credentials, login status, and UI selectors. It provides methods to update state, persist to storage, and initialize from saved preferences.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads initial state from storage at app start, including credentials and UI settings.

methods.name: loadFromStorage
methods.description: Loads credentials, selectors, flags, and settings from SharedPreferences and CredentialStore.

methods.name: saveToStorage
methods.description: Persists credentials and UI settings to SharedPreferences and CredentialStore.

methods.name: clearStorage
methods.description: Clears saved preferences and credentials from storage, resets app state.

methods.name: setLoading
methods.description: Sets the loading flag and notifies listeners.

methods.name: updateCredentials
methods.description: Updates credentials object and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setLoggedIn
methods.description: Sets the login status flag and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setSelectors
methods.description: Updates UI selectors and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setAutoSubmit
methods.description: Updates auto-submit flag and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setSettingsPagePathOrUrl
methods.description: Updates settings page path or URL and notifies listeners.
